reason: This plugin is primarily a cost-visibility extension for DeepSeek chat sessions in the DSH web GUI: README and package metadata describe it as a DSH plugin that computes and displays conversation and per-message costs using snapshot-anchored pricing, plus account balance and related settings UI. Its primary user-facing behavior is presenting billed and estimated costs directly in conversation panels and tabs, with host-side projection logic behind a DSH route.

summaries.zh: DSH Cost Meter 是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的对话计费插件，可在聊天界面显示余额信息，并按消息与会话展示成本数据与估算结果。
summaries.en: DSH Cost Meter is a DeepSeek Harness web GUI plugin that shows account balance and cost data for chat sessions, including per-message and session-level cost views.

capabilities: Network access for pricing/balance data sources
Host-side cost route and projection data exposure
Conversation UI injection for per-message/session cost displays

reasons.code: Uses external pricing and balance lookups, including official pricing pages and balance endpoint, creating network and external-data dependency.
Maintains and selects append-only price snapshots plus per-session cost projections, introducing persistent cost data handling in storage.
Adds multiple host-injected chat surfaces (composer dock, cost tab, assistant action chip, header utility pill, settings card) for cost and balance presentation.

capabilities: Network access for pricing/balance data sources
Host-side cost route and projection data exposure
Conversation UI injection for per-message/session cost displays
